description: Short whoosh — quick swipe/slide accent, fast element move, snappy transition. Sync to the motion.
Long cinematic riser (~10s build, peak at the end). Trigger at (climax_time − 10.03s) so it crests exactly on the reveal.
Bass impact hit — logo/hero snap, headline slam. Trigger on the visual landing; decay carries into the next shot (J-cut).
Bright sparkle / shimmer — magical reveal or 'shine' highlight on a hero element. Sync to the highlight.
Soft melodic chime — gentle positive beat: success/confirmation or a lighthearted transition. Sync to the visual moment.
Quiet short click — low-key UI tap / soft selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action.
Quick pop — element appear/spawn, chip/tag/badge in. Small precise accent, sync to the pop-in.
Sharp electronic ping — punchy accent on a key reveal or data point. Sync to the beat.
